canDoYue: 你識講遲五分鐘、大門上車、車牌 MX 42 17、白色豐田、喺應用程式改目的地、用卡畀錢，收據用電郵。
canDoEn: Say you are five minutes late, meet Ray at the main door, read plate MX 42 17 on a white Toyota, change the destination in the app, pay by card, and get the receipt by email.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hi Ray, I'm running about five minutes late for the taxi. Can you still wait?
dialogue.glossYue: Ray，我叫的士遲咗大約五分鐘。你可唔可以等埋？
dialogue.say: Hi Ray, I'm running about five minutes late for the taxi. Can you still wait?

dialogue.speaker: ray
dialogue.text: No problem. I'll still wait at the pick-up point beside the main front door.
dialogue.glossYue: 冇問題。我會喺大門旁邊嘅上車點等你。
dialogue.say: No problem. I'll still wait at the pick-up point beside the main front door.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Thanks a lot. What's your plate number, and which colour car should I look for?
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝。你車牌幾多，我要搵咩顏色嘅車？
dialogue.say: Thanks a lot. What's your plate number, and which colour car should I look for?

dialogue.speaker: ray
dialogue.text: The plate number is MX 42 17, and the car is a white Toyota beside that front door.
dialogue.glossYue: 車牌係 MX 42 17，白色豐田，就喺大門旁邊。
dialogue.say: The plate number is MX 42 17, and the car is a white Toyota beside that front door.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Thanks. Can we change the destination to the airport instead of the hotel lobby please?
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝。可唔可以將目的地由酒店大堂改去機場？
dialogue.say: Thanks. Can we change the destination to the airport instead of the hotel lobby please?

dialogue.speaker: ray
dialogue.text: Sure. Just change the destination in the app and the new fare will update automatically.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。你喺應用程式改目的地，新車費會自動更新。
dialogue.say: Sure. Just change the destination in the app and the new fare will update automatically.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can I pay by card when we arrive, and will I get a receipt after?
dialogue.glossYue: 到埗可唔可以用卡畀錢，之後有冇收據？
dialogue.say: Can I pay by card when we arrive, and will I get a receipt after?

dialogue.speaker: ray
dialogue.text: Yes, card is fine, and the receipt will be emailed after the whole ride ends.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以，用卡得。成程完咗收據會電郵畀你。
dialogue.say: Yes, card is fine, and the receipt will be emailed after the whole ride ends.
